support.title: How can we
support.emailUsText: Get a response within one business day.
support.requestAccessText: New buyer? Apply for a wholesale account.
support.faq1q: How do I get wholesale pricing?
support.faq1a: Wholesale prices are visible to approved buyers. Request access with your company details and business license, and once approved you'll see wholesale pricing across all brands.
support.faq2a: We offer NET 30 and NET 60 terms for approved wholesale accounts, depending on order volume and account history.
support.faq3q: Which countries do you ship to?
support.faq3a: We ship across Italy and the EU from Italy-based warehouses. Contact us for specific delivery timelines to your region.
support.faq4q: What is the minimum order quantity?
support.faq4a: MOQ varies by product and is shown on each product page. Most items have low minimums to support smaller retailers.
support.faq5q: How do I become a buyer?
support.faq5a: Click 'Request Access', complete the B2B application with your company info and VAT number, and upload your business license. We review applications within 48 hours.

about.title: Connecting brands with
about.heroText: We are a globally oriented trade service provider dedicated to helping brands seamlessly connect with international markets.
about.para1: By combining market insights, strategic planning, and execution, we bridge the gap between businesses and global opportunities. Rooted in extensive market knowledge and strong personal relationships, we evaluate the objectives of all parties involved to ensure flawless and profitable transactions.
about.para2: Through innovation, sustainability, and collaboration, we strive to create an interconnected trade ecosystem that transcends borders and promotes equitable growth for businesses seeking to unlock their international potential. With a comprehensive network spanning logistics, strategic partnerships, and market insights, we offer unparalleled capabilities that ensure seamless cross-border transactions and long-term success.
about.missionText: To foster cross-border trade, promote sustainable business practices, and drive mutual growth with our partners.
about.businessText: At ZGlobal, we provide tailored solutions that drive growth, innovation, and sustainability — helping businesses across diverse industries navigate the complexities of today's global economy.
